bryan.name: Bryan
bryan.title: BRYAN — THE CONDUIT BENDER
bryan.bio: Armed with his trusty red conduit bender and an unwavering belief that he can fix absolutely anything, Bryan charges into battle against Alextron's mechanical army. His greatest strength is his determination. His greatest weakness? Thinking every problem can be solved by bending it 30 degrees.

carlos.name: Carlos
carlos.title: CARLOS — THE ROOFTOP OUTLAW
carlos.bio: A rooftop cowboy with a Milwaukee nail gun and absolutely no regard for OSHA regulations. Carlos doesn't believe in complicated strategies. He believes in hitting things harder, preferably while looking cool doing it. If Alextron's robots have a warranty, he's about to void it.
carlos.passive_description: The first Attack played each combat deals 1 additional damage.

manny.name: Manny
manny.title: MANNY — THE SUPERINTENDENT
manny.bio: Manny has spent his entire career telling other people what to do, and he's not about to stop because of a robot apocalypse. Armed with a clipboard, a suspiciously long punch list, and the ability to turn any emergency into a mandatory meeting, he keeps the crew organized while everyone else does the dangerous work.
manny.passive_description: Start each combat with 1 additional card in hand.

cristian_hb.name: Cristian & HB
cristian_hb.title: CRISTIAN & HB — THE LIFT OPERATORS
cristian_hb.bio: Two workers. One blue Genie scissor lift. Zero approved battle plans. Cristian handles the controls while HB provides unsolicited tactical advice from the platform. Together, they've discovered that almost any problem can be avoided by simply raising the lift another twenty feet. Unfortunately, neither has figured out how to get down.
